senses.gloss: f. (v. בַּרְיוֹנָא) rebellion, defiance of the law.
units: <cite ref="Sotah 19b:13">Sot. 19ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Sotah 20a:3">20ᵃ</cite> <he>מחמת ב׳</he> (refusal to drink the searching water) in defiance, opp. <cite ref="T01137"><he>רתיתא</he></cite>, <cite ref="B00675"><he>ביעתותא</he></cite>. *[<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Proverbs 25:20">Targ. Prov. XXV, 20</cite>, prob. to be read <cite ref="B00139"><he>בְּדִיחוּתָא</he></cite>; ed. Lag. <cite ref="K01159"><he>כַּרְיוּתָא</he></cite>.
